entries.reason: iOS 6 has the video format description and its avcC atom, and only lacks the function that reads the parameter sets out of it
entries.effect: answers the SPS, PPS and extension sets of the avcC atom by index with the count and the NAL unit header length, and the errors -12710 and -12712 the host answers for the same descriptions
entries.source: the host's own CoreMedia, which the port is held against, case by case, by tests/backports/host/coremedia; an iPad 2 running 6.1.3, asked with dlsym, for what iOS 6 exports

entries.reason: rank 14 of the frameworks demand table, LOAD-FAIL for session and telegram; iOS 6 has CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate and the avcC sample description atom, and only lacks the function that builds them from parameter sets
entries.effect: builds the avcC record from the SPS, PPS and SPS extension units, reads the dimensions and the field count, chroma location, pixel aspect ratio, full range flag and colour description out of the sequence parameter set, and makes the description with CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate; the error codes -12710, -12712 and -12714 fall where the host's do
entries.source: the host's own CoreMedia and the parameter sets of the host's H.264 encoder, which the port is held against by tests/backports/host/coremedia; the armv7 cache ladder, which first exports the function at 7.0
